applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Use this specification for the generic CedarPay Excel template. Platform-specific exports have their own format and should be uploaded through their customized entry.

| Required column | Content requirement |
|---|---|
| `Order ID` | Nonempty; at most 64 characters. |
| `Paid Date` | Nonempty; use the date format for the relevant platform. |
| `Order Total` | Numeric, with at most two decimal places. |
| `Currency Code` | Three uppercase letters. |
| `Product Title` | Nonempty; at most 512 characters. |
| `Product Quantity` | An integer. |
| `Buyer Name/Buyer ID` | Nonempty; at most 128 characters. |
| `Shipping Address` | Nonempty; at most 512 characters. |

A missing required column invalidates the file for quota processing. Passing the file-format checks does not establish that every order is eligible under the platform's date, status or source rules.

For a processing error, retain the original file and the generated exception file. Submit both with a screenshot of the error that includes the computer's date and time. Use the upload page's guide for platform-specific export and date-format instructions. If no download guide is available, obtain the export instructions from the platform.

To expose the generic upload entry, complete the seller ID, platform and store-link fields under Complete store information, save them and return to Upload sales records.
